Cortney earned her B.S. in Chemistry from Northwestern Oklahoma State University and is currently in the MSMS Program at Hawaiʻi Pacific University. Her primary interest is scientific diving as a tool for underwater research, data collection, and environmental monitoring. She is particularly interested in hands-on fieldwork and using diving techniques to investigate marine ecosystems.
